import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import type { SelectOption } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { FormControlController } from '../../controllers/form-control-controller.js';
export declare class NativeSelect extends KrdsElement {
    static formAssociated: boolean;
    static properties: {
        options: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        value: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        defaultValue: {
            attribute: string;
        };
        name: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            reflect: boolean;
        };
        disabled: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            reflect: boolean;
        };
        required: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        invalid: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        hint: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        error: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        size: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    options: readonly SelectOption[];
    value: string | undefined;
    defaultValue: string | undefined;
    name: string;
    disabled: boolean;
    required: boolean;
    invalid: boolean;
    hint: string;
    error: string;
    size: string;
    readonly formControl: FormControlController;
    private selection;
    constructor();
    get committedValue(): string;
    resetControl(): void;
    restoreControl(state: string | FormData | File | null): void;
    formResetCallback(): void;
    formDisabledCallback(value: boolean): void;
    formStateRestoreCallback(state: string | FormData | File | null): void;
    updated(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    private change;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
